results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: This article discusses the findings of Professor Fabio Giglietto's study 'A Pretty Blunt Approach,' which analyzed how Meta's algorithms dramatically reduced the organic visibility of Italian parliamentarians on Facebook while unintentionally amplifying extremist and Eurosceptic accounts. Giglietto is quoted explaining the asymmetric impact of the policy.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: Press coverage discussing the significant public, institutional, and media impact of Professor Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's algorithmic filtering. The article highlights how his findings prompted a formal query to the European Commission regarding Meta's compliance with the Digital Services Act.

results.title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
results.snippet: A detailed report of Fabio Giglietto's scientific audit of Meta's political content reduction policy. The article outlines how Giglietto analyzed over 2.5 million Facebook posts to show that mainstream politicians lost over 70% of their reach compared to 2021, while political extremist accounts actually increased their overall visibility.

results.title: Più visibilità agli estremisti che ai parlamentari, l'impatto del “filtro” di Meta sulle elezioni
results.snippet: This news article highlights Professor Giglietto's working paper on Meta's content distribution changes. It explains the 'asymmetric' results, detailing how extremist accounts circumvented algorithmic suppression by drastically increasing their posting frequency.

results.title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
results.snippet: Media coverage featuring the research of Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino, focusing on how Meta's algorithm inadvertently punished democratic institutions and rewarded conspiracy theorists during major European electoral cycles.
